brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: One Hex base · Full (piece:0,0,0) closed on all faces: solid cover on top (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and six solid end caps on the side faces (check_build: ok, meshClash clear).

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: A Port louvre (port:0#0,0#0, hex-port-louvre) is fitted to one face of the base. The six caps went on the side faces, so the port is on the remaining face, which I believe is the bottom; I did not confirm that visually. The port vents the closed cell without admitting rain, per the catalog. No board is modelled, and airflow itself is not checked by the configurator.

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell enclosure: a full hex base with a solid top cover, six solid end caps on the sides, and one louvre port on the remaining face. The configurator reports no rule errors and a clear mesh check. The board is not part of the catalog, so it is not modelled; the printed material and any real ventilation performance are not verified here.
